## Imagery, shape, texture, and material

When references show frosted overlays over photography or rich imagery, require matte frosted overlays as a depth system:

- Soft blur band over the substrate (backdrop-style diffusion, not specular shine).
- Warm or cool translucent fill at low-to-mid opacity.
- Quiet gray or hairline border; keep edges crisp on the chip/panel.
- Matte finish only — no reflections, chrome, or heavy drop shadows on the overlay.

Pale translucent circles inside a photo are atmospheric bokeh, not a substitute for frosted UI overlays.

## Forbidden shortcuts

Ban glossy reflective glassmorphism: specular highlights, chrome, metallic bevels, and heavy shadowed glass cards.

Do not collapse matte frosted overlays into a blanket “remove glass effects” rule when overlay-over-imagery frost is evidenced.

## Generation checklist

- If frosted overlays over imagery are part of the taste, keep the matte overlay recipe (blur band, translucent fill, quiet border).
- If the result turns glossy or reflective, remove gloss/specular treatments only; keep matte frost when evidenced.
